north_window.description: Stardew Valley wall decoration, a big window set flat in an interior wall, square-on, alone on a transparent background, three tiles wide and two tall, one tile is 16 pixels, dark coloured (not black) outlines: a wide cottage window with a painted cream wooden frame and two large panes, clear soft blue daylight sky and a little green of trees through the glass, a thin pale curtain tied back at each side, a deep wooden sill

counter.description: Stardew Valley interior furniture, one object alone on a transparent background, drawn square-on from the front with its top seen as a flat band above the front face, no side faces visible at all, one tile is 16 pixels, warm wood colours, dark coloured (not black) outlines: a small cottage kitchen counter, two tiles wide, a butcher block top with a copper kettle and a chopping board with bread on it, two small cupboard doors with brass knobs below

stove.description: Stardew Valley interior furniture, one object alone on a transparent background, drawn square-on from the front, no side faces, one tile wide and two tall, one tile is 16 pixels, dark coloured (not black) outlines: a small black cast-iron cottage cookstove, a little saucepan on its top, a small oven door with a brass handle and a warm orange glow at its grate, no chimney pipe

jar_shelf.description: Stardew Valley wall decoration, a wall shelf hung flat on a wall, square-on, alone on a transparent background, two tiles wide, one tile is 16 pixels, warm wood colours, dark coloured (not black) outlines: two short wooden kitchen shelves on brackets, with glass jars of jam, honey and dried beans, a little stack of plates and a teacup
